text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is here. Sakura Chiyono O and I have been training as hard as we possibly can without overstraining her body.
choice_data_list: All we can do now is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right, that's everything. I've checked my cleats too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But maybe I should double-check them…
choice_data_list: Want to look over them together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Uh, um…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If you're offering, then… Yes, please.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew! Thanks for doing that for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now my clothes and my cleats are all ready! I slept like a log last night too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've got nothing to worry about! I'm going to go out there and win this G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Of course I am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is my chance to show how much I've improved from all my training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just know I'm still in the middle of my growth period!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter whether or not I'm at my peak. I'm going to show everyone how far I've come!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Yasuda Kinen! The fastest Umamusume have gathered here to duke it out in this 1,600-meter race!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wait a second, isn't that Super Creek? Why's she cheering for Bamboo Memory?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Oh, you didn't know? They're actually pretty close.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Super Creek was the one who encouraged Bamboo to run on turf.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Creek told her she'd be just as good out here, and she was right. So here we are now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's really something. If an incredible racer like Creek is cheering her on, that must mean Bamboo Memory's pretty solid too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Bamboo is quite powerful. ♪
